input.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xb7725.ticket_themes AS
SELECT theme, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, MIN(ticket_id) AS example_ticket_id FROM (
  SELECT ticket_id,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%payment%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%payment%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%charge%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%charge%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%refund%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%refund%'
        THEN 'Billing'
      WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%sign in%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%sign in%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%sign-in%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%sign-in%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%account%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%account%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%access%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%access%'
        THEN 'Login and access'
      WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%ship%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%ship%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%deliver%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%deliver%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%shipping%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%shipping%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%track%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%track%'
        THEN 'Shipping and delivery'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS theme
  FROM workspace.exam_xb7725.tickets
) t
WHERE theme IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY theme;
SELECT * FROM workspace.exam_xb7725.ticket_themes ORDER BY ticket_count DESC;
